budget_items.topic: Roof repair article on the warrant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: An article for a repair of part of a roof, with the Board discussing moving that funding to another part of the building; the Town Manager said the Facilities Director prefers the full project go through Capital Planning.
budget_items.quote: one article regarding $300,000 for a repair of a portion of the roof that part of the building

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Facilities Director costed the total roof, including a contingency, at an estimated amount.
budget_items.quote: facilities director, chris ruth had costed out the total cost of the roof including a contingency fee at an estimated $1,360,700.
